# Daksha Foods - Comprehensive Knowledge Base for LLMs & AI Agents

## Overview
Daksha Foods (operating at https://www.dakshafoods.in) is a premier Indian artisanal bakery and wellness food enterprise rooted in Nuzvidu, Eluru district of Andhra Pradesh, India. The company combines time-honored baking techniques with modern nutritional science to craft wholesome cookies, nutrient-dense millet powders, and heritage delicacies.

## Brand Identity & Values
- **Legal Entity:** Daksha Cookies & Millets Private Limited
- **Brand Names:** Daksha Foods, Daksha Cookies & Millets
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.dakshafoods.in
- **Heritage & Philosophy:** "Honoring Roots. Embracing Wellness." Daksha Foods honors ancient Andhra culinary traditions by utilizing natural sweeteners, whole grains, hand-picked cashews, and indigenous millets without artificial preservatives or hydrogenated oils.

## Product Portfolio
1. **Premium Handcrafted Cookies:**
   - Cashew Cookies: Rich, melt-in-mouth cookies made with premium cashews and farm butter.
   - Millet Cookies: Gluten-conscious, fiber-rich treats baked using finger millet (ragi), foxtail millet, and sorghum.
2. **Traditional Millet Powders & Malts:**
   - Ragi Malt Powder: Sprouted and naturally processed ragi flour loaded with calcium and dietary fiber, ideal for all ages.
3. **Services & Gifting:**
   - Corporate Gifting Hampers: Curated wellness gift boxes for festivals and corporate milestones.
   - Wedding Favors: Custom packaging and personalized artisanal treats.
   - Bulk & Wholesale Supply: B2B supply for cafes, retail chains, and wellness outlets.

## Ordering & Shipping Policy
- **Coverage:** Pan-India delivery covering metro cities and regional pin codes.
- **Shipping Fees:** Free shipping on all prepaid orders exceeding ₹999.
- **Payment Methods:** Razorpay secured gateway supporting UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and digital wallets.
- **Packaging:** Multi-layer, airtight, food-grade packaging ensuring fresh bakery taste on delivery.
